SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua insha za maelezo katika matini mbalimbali, b) kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kuzingatia muundo na mtindo ufaao, c) kuchangamkia utungaji wa insha za maelezo ili kuimarisha uandishi bora. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua vifungu vya insha za maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi (k.v. maelezo kuhusu upandaji wa miche, kusafisha darasa, kufua nguo, kuzuia mmomonyoko wa udongo, kupanda miti),  kushiriki na wenzake kujadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya maelezo,  kuandika insha ya maelezo isiyopungua maneno 150 akizingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu unaojumuisha methali na nahau alizojifunza awali, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni shughuli gani zinazoweza kuandikiwa insha za maelezo?

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.sub_strand: 7.4.1 Ngeli ya KU-KU (Vipindi 2)
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 7.4.1 Ngeli ya KU-KU (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya KU- KU, b) kuandika nomino za ngeli ya KU-KU katika umoja na wingi, c) kuandika umoja na wingi wa mafungu ya maneno katika ngeli ya KU-KU, d) kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya KU- KU katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya KU- KU (kama vile kupika, kufyeka, kuzuru, kukariri, kufua) kwenye kadi, mti maneno, tarakilishi au kapu la maneno,  kuandika nomino katika ngeli ya KU-KU katika umoja na wingi akiwa na wenzake,  kusikiliza usomaji wa nomino za ngeli ya KU-KU kutoka kwenye tepurekoda au kinasasauti,  kuandika mafungu ya maneno yenye nomino za ngeli ya KU-KU katika umoja na wi.ngi. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni nomino zipi hupatikana katika ngeli ya KU-KU?

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.sub_strand: 7.4.2 Ngeli ya KU-KU (Vipindi 2)
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 7.4.2 Ngeli ya KU-KU (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua viambishi vipatanishi vya ngeli ya KU-KU kwenye sentensi, b) kuunda sentensi akitumia nomino za ngeli ya KU- KU katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi, c) kufurahia matumizi ya ngeli ya KU-KU katika mawasiliano, SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua viambishi vya ngeli ya KU-KU katika sentensi kwa kuvipigia mstari au kuvikoleza rangi katika tarakilishi,  kutumia nomino za ngeli ya KU-KU katika sentensi akiwa na wenzake,  kusikiliza usomaji wa sentensi zilizoundwa kutokana na nomino za ngeli ya KU- KU kutoka kwenye tepurekoda au kinasasauti,  kuunda sentensi kwa kutumia nomino ya ngeli ya KU-KU akiwa peke yake au kwa kushirikiana na wenzake,  kujaza nafasi kwa kutumia KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, nomino za ngeli ya KU-KU huchukua viambishi gani katika sentensi?

chunks.subject: Kiswahili

chunks.text: STRAND: 8.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 8.1.1 Visawe (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua maneno matatu yenye maana sawa katika matini, b) kutumia visawe ifaavyo katika mawasiliano, c) kuthamini matumizi ya visawe katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua maneno matatu yenye maana sawa (k.v. nyumbani, mastakimu, chengo; barabara, tariki, baraste; jitimai, huzuni, simanzi) kwa kutumia kapu la maneno, kadi za maneno, mti maneno, kuburura kwa kutumia tarakilishi, n.k.,  kueleza maana ya maneno matatu yenye maana sawa akiwa na wenzake,  kuambatanisha maneno matatu yenye maana sawa kutoka kapu maneno, mti maneno, ubao, chati, vyombo vya kidijitali, kadi maneno n.k,  kuhusisha visawe na vifaa KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Maneno yaliyo na maana sawa yana umuhimu gani katika mawasiliano?

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.sub_strand: 8.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Vipindi 3)
chunks.text: STRAND: 8.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 8.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua mchezo wa kuigiza katika matini, b) kusoma mchezo mfupi wa kuigiza kwa ufasaha, c) kueleza maana ya msamiati uliotumiwa katika mchezo wa kuigiza, d) kuonyesha ufahamu wa mchezo wa kuigiza kwa kujibu maswali, e) kuigiza mchezo mfupi ili kukuza uwezo wa kujieleza, SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kueleza maana ya mchezo wa kuigiza akiwa katika kikundi,  kutambua mchezo wa kuigiza, wahusika na maelekezo katika matini mbalimbali kama vile vitabu, chati na vilevile kwa kutumia tarakilishi,  kusoma mchezo wa kuigiza akizingatia wahusika, maelekezo na ujumbe,  kushiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu msamiati wa suala lengwa (ndege wa porini) uliotumiwa katika mchezo wa kuigiza (k.v. chiriku, kasuku, tai, korongo, mwewe na kanga), KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Umewahi kusoma michezo ipi ya kuigiza? 2. Unakumbuka nini katika mchezo uliowahi kuusoma? 3. Kusoma michezo ya kuigiza kuna umuhimu gani?

chunks.subject: Kiswahili

chunks.text: STRAND: 8.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 8.3.1 Insha za masimulizi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze, a) kueleza sifa za insha ya masimuizi ili kuibainisha, b) kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo, c) kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,  kushiriki na wenzake kujadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya masimulizi,  kuandika insha isiyopungua maneno 150, inayosimulia tukio linalohusiana na ndege wa porini kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu,  kuandika insha ya masimulizi katika vifaa vya kidijitali na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni mambo gani unayozingatia ili kuandika insha ya masimulizi ya kuvutia?

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.sub_strand: 8.4.1 Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi Vipindi 3)
chunks.text: STRAND: 8.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 8.4.1 Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua vitenzi katika hali ya kutendewa, kutendeka na kutendana katika matini ili kuvitofautisha, b) kutumia vitenzi katika hali za kutendewa, kutendeka na kutendana ipasavyo anapowasiliana, c) kuchangamkia matumizi ya vitenzi katika hali ya SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua vitenzi katika hali za kutendewa, kutendeka na kutendana katika chati, jedwali, kapu la maneno, mti maneno, ubao na vyombo vya kidijitali,  kunyambua vitenzi katika hali lengwa akiwa peke yake, wakiwa wawiliwawili au katika vikundi,  kutumia vitenzi katika hali lengwa kwenye sentensi,  kushirikiana na wenzake kujaza nafasi katika jedwali la mnyambuliko vitenzi kwenye daftari au kwa kutumia tarakilishi,  kuandika sentensi upya kwa kutumia vitenzi katika hali mbalimbali. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, vitenzi vinaweza kubadilika vipi mwishoni ili kuleta maana mbalimbali?

chunks.subject: Kiswahili

chunks.text: STRAND: 9.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 9.1.1 Mazungumzo ya Kimuktadha (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua miktadha mbalimbali kunakotumiwa lugha rasmi ili kukuza mawasiliano, b) kutumia lugha katika miktadha rasmi ili kufanikisha mawasiliano, c) kuchangamkia matumizi ya lugha katika miktadha rasmi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua miktadha kunakotumiwa lugha rasmi (k.v ofisini, hospitalini, mahakamani na bungeni),  kusikiliza mazungumzo rasmi kwa kutazama maigizo kwenye vyombo vya kidijitali kama vile video, rununu, runinga, tarakilishi n.k,  kushiriki katika maigizo ya mazungumzo ya miktadha rasmi akishirikiana na wenzake,  kushiriki katika mazungumzo rasmi nje ya darasa k.m. akiwa kwenye gwaride na mazingira rasmi.  kutambua nidhamu ya lugha KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni wapi katika shughuli zetu za kila siku tunaitumia lugha rasmi?

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.sub_strand: 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana (Vipindi 3)
chunks.text: STRAND: 9.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua matini za aina mbalimbali za kusoma na kuchagua zinazomvutia, b) kusoma matini alizochagua ili kufaidika na ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa, c) kufurahia usomaji wa aina mbalimbali za matini ili kupanua mawazo yake. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: kuchagua matini (k.v. vitabu, majarida, magazeti) zinazomvutia maktabani na mtandaoni,  kusoma matini alizochagua ili kufaidi ujumbe uliomo,  kuwatolea wenzake muhtasari wa kile alichosoma kwenye matini ili kupashana ujumbe na kuchocheana kusoma zaidi kwa ajili ya kujifurahisha,  kujadiliana na wenzake matini ambayo wamesoma kwa kuzingatia ukuzaji wa msamiati. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Ni habari zipi unazopenda kusoma kwenye matini? 2. Unachagua matini hayo kwa nini?

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.sub_strand: 9.3.1 Insha za Maelezo (Vipindi 2)
chunks.text: STRAND: 9.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 9.3.1 Insha za Maelezo (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze, a) kutambua vifungu vya maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali, b) kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata mtindo na muundo ufaao, c) kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri wenye ujumbe mahususi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua vifungu vya maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,  ashiriki na wenzake kujadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya maelezo,  kuandika insha ya maelezo isiyopungua maneno 150 kwa kuzingatia msamiati unaohusu suala lengwa na kwa kuzingatia vigezo kama vile: ujumbe, tahajia anwani, muundo, mtindo, mapambo ya lugha k.v methali, nahau, tashbihi, istiari n.k. alizojifunza awali,  kuandika insha ya maelezo mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini,  kuwasomea wenzake insha KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, unaweza kuandika insha ya maelezo juu ya mada gani? ,

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.sub_strand: 9.4.1 Vinyume vya Vitenzi (Vipindi 2)
chunks.text: STRAND: 9.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 9.4.1 Vinyume vya Vitenzi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua vinyume vya vitenzi katika matini, b) kuunda sentensi kwa kutumia vinyume vya vitenzi, c) kuchangamkia matumizi ya vinyume vya vitenzi katika mawasiliano ya kila siku. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua vinyume vya vitenzi (k.m. Simama- keti, cheka-lia, enda- rudi, anika-anua n.k) katika chati, kadi za maneno, kapu maneno, mti maneno au vifaa vya kidijitali,  kushirikiana na wenzake kutafuta vinyume vya vitenzi kwa kurejelea orodha ya vitenzi aliyopewa,  kutalii mazingira yake na kuunda orodha ya vinyume vya vitenzi anavyovitambua,  atunge sentensi kwa kutumia vinyume vya vitenzi kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi,  kuandika upya sentensi kwa kutumia vinyume vya vitenzi. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni vitenzi gani unavyoweza kutambua vinyume vyake?

chunks.subject: Kiswahili

chunks.text: STRAND: 10.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 10.1.1 Tashbihi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua tashbihi za tabia katika matini ili kuzibainisha, b) kutumia tashbihi za tabia kwa usahihi katika sentensi, c) kufurahia matumizi ya tashbihi za tabia katika mawasiliano ya kila siku. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua tashbihi za tabia (k.v. mjanja kama sungura, mlafi kama fisi, mwenye maneno mengi kama kasuku) katika vitabu, matini, chati na vyombo vya kidijitali,  kueleza maana ya tashbihi mbalimbali za tabia kwa kutoa mifano,  kukamilisha tashbihi mbalimbali za tabia akiwa peke yake au kwa kushirikiana na wenzake darasani,  kujaza nafasi katika sentensi kwa kutumia tashbihi mbalimbali za tabia,  kutumia tashbihi za tabia katika sentensi akiwa katika vikundi. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni tashbihi zipi hutumiwa kuelezea tabia?

chunks.subject: Kiswahili

chunks.text: STRAND: 10.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 10.2.1 Matini ya Kidijitali (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua na kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali, b) kutambua na kufungua faili iliyo na kifungu cha kusoma ili kuimarisha umilisi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi, c) kusakura kwenye tovuti salama ili kupata vifungu vya kusoma, d) kutumia vyombo vya kidijitali kwa urahisi kupata matini zinazolengwa, SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua na kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama kutoka kwenye chati au kwenye tarakilishi na mitandao,  kutambua jina la faili lengwa kwenye tarakilishi na kufanya mazoezi ya kufungua na kufunga,  kutambua mitandao salama yenye matini inayoafiki kiwango na mahitaji yake,  kutambua umuhimu wa kutoa habari kwa mwalimu, mzazi au mlezi wake endapo atapata ujumbe kutoka kwa watu asiowajua mtandaoni na kutowasiliana nao, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Unapenda kusoma habari kuhusu nini mtandaoni? 2. Ni hatua gani za kiusalama unazozing atia unapotafuta habari mtandaoni?

chunks.subject: Kiswahili

chunks.text: STRAND: 10.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 10.4.1 Nyakati na Hali (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua viambishi vya hali ya mazoea na hali timilifu katika kitenzi, b) kutambua vitenzi katika hali ya mazoea na hali timilifu katika matini, c) kutumia vitenzi vya hali ya mazoea na timilifu katika sentensi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano, d) kufurahia matumizi ya hali ya mazoea na timilifu katika mawasiliano. Jinsi ya kuwekeza na faida za uwekezaji,  kutumia ishara za mwili zifaazo k.v ishara za uso, za mikono na mabega kuimarisha masimulizi yake,  kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu ubora wa KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni nini unachozingatia katika kutoa masimulizi?

Je, ni mambo gani yanayokuvutia unaposoma kifungu cha ufahamu? 2. Unatumia njia gani ili kujua maana ya msamiati uliotumiwa katika kifungu?

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.sub_strand: 11.3.1 Baruapepe (Vipindi 2)
chunks.text: STRAND: 11.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 11.3.1 Baruapepe (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua baruapepe kwa kuzingatia muundo wake, b) kuandika baruapepe kwa kuzingatia ujumbe, muundo na mtindo, c) kuchangamkia uandishi wa baruapepe katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua muundo wa baruapepe kwa kurejelea kielelezo chake kilichochapishwa au kwenye tarakilishi,  kujadili sehemu mbalimbali za baruapepe kama vile anwanipepe ya mtumaji (k.m. tina18@gmail.com), anwanipepe ya mpokeaji, mada ya baruapepe, mtajo, mwili, hitimisho na jina la mwandishi/ mtumaji,  kuandika baruapepe kwa rafiki, mzazi, mwalimu n.k akishirikiana na wenzake darasani, kwa kutumia tarakilishi akizingatia muundo wa uandishi wa baruapepe,  kuandika baruapepe akiwa peke yake,  kutuma baruapepe aliyoiandika KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Unazingatia vipengele gani unapoandika baruapepe?

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.sub_strand: 11.4.1 Ukanushaji (Vipindi 3)
chunks.text: STRAND: 11.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 11.4.1 Ukanushaji (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua viambishi vya wakati na nafsi katika sentensi, b) kukanusha viambishi vya nafsi na wakati katika sentensi kwa usahihi, c) kutunga sentensi sahihi zenye viambishi vya nafsi na wakati na kuzikanusha, d) kufurahia ukanushaji wa viambishi vya nafsi na wakati katika sentensi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua viambishi vya nafsi (ni, tu, u, m, a, wa) na vya wakati (li, na, ta) katika vitenzi kwa kuvipigia mistari kwenye vitabu au kuvikolezea wino kwenye tarakilishi,  kutambua viambishi vya wakati li, na, ta katika hali yakinishi na ku, ta, si, ha, katika hali kanushi,  kusoma sentensi zenye viambishi lengwa kwenye vitabu au tarakilishi katika hali yakinishi na kanushi,  kukanusha sentensi akizingatia nafsi na nyakati kwenye daftari au kwa kutumia tarakilishi,  kusikiliza au kutazama vipindi KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Viambishi vya nafsi katika vitenzi ni vipi? 2. Unatumia viambishi gani wakati wa kukanusha vitenzi?

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.sub_strand: 11.4.2 Ukubwa na udogo wa nomino (Vipindi 2)
chunks.text: STRAND: 11.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 11.4.2 Ukubwa na udogo wa nomino (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa herufi m- na zenye mzizi wa silabi mbili, b) kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa herufi m- katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo, c) kubadilisha nomino katika hali ya wastani kuwa katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo, d) kutumia nomino zinazoanza kwa herufi m- katika hali ya ukubwa na SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa herufi m- na zenye mzizi wa silabi mbili (k.m mtoto, mlango, mkate na mlima) kwenye chati, ubao, mti maneno, kapu la maneno au kifaa cha kidijitali,  kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa herufi m- na zenye mzizi wa silabi mbili katika ukubwa na udogo (k.v. mtoto (toto- kitoto), mlango (lango - kilango), mkate (kate- kikate),  kushiriki katika vikundi kubadilisha nomino kutoka hali ya wastani hadi hali ya ukubwa na udogo, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni nomino gani unazoweza kutaja ukubwa wake?

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.sub_strand: 11.4.3 Ukubwa na udogo wa nomino (Vipindi 2)
chunks.text: STRAND: 11.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 11.4.3 Ukubwa na udogo wa nomino (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa herufi n- ili kuzitofautisha na nonimo nyingine, b) kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa herufi n- katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo, c) kubadilisha nomino katika hali wastani kuwa katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo, d) kutumia nomino katika hali ya SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa herufi n- kwenye chati, ubao, mti maneno, kapu la maneno au kifaa cha kidijitali,  kushiriki katika vikundi kubadilisha nomino kutoka hali ya wastani hadi hali ya ukubwa na udogo,  kushiriki katika mchezo wa vikundi ambapo kikundi kimoja kitataja wastani wa nomino, kingine ukubwa na kingine kutaja udogo wa nomino hiyo,  kupewa orodha ya nomino katika hali ya ukubwa na orodha nyingine ya nomino katika hali ya udogo kwenye tarakilishi ili aziburure kuziambatanisha, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni nomino gani unazoweza kutaja udogo wake?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 1.1 Phonological Awareness
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.1 Phonological Awareness. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub Strand, the learner should be able to: a) discriminate initial and final sounds in Chinese syllables, b) compose simple sentences on various themes, c) exhibit confidence in manipulating sounds in spoken language. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen and repeat initials and finals from a recording (z, c, s, zh, ch, sh, r, w, y, ai ,ei, ui ,ou ,iu, ie, ü ,un, an, en, un, ang, eng, ing, ong),  identify initials and finals from the given syllables and say them out (你、 我、他/她、朋、友、叫、什么、名 字、是、不、女孩、男孩),  make self-introductions (hello + name) with the correct tones (你/您好，我 叫.....,你呢? .....),  listen to an introduction of a friend and respond to simple questions (我朋友叫 什么名字？ 他是不是女孩、男 孩？）,  introduce their friend (我朋友叫... 他是 男生）to their peers, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do you articulate words accurately?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 1.2 Phonological Awareness
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.2 Phonological Awareness. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub Strand, the learner should be able to: a) reproduce rhyming syllables and words in spoken language, b) apply vocabulary acquired in forming sentences, c) appreciate the different language sounds and patterns in a language. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen to a group of words and indicate rhyming and non-rhyming words cooperatively,  repeat saying the group of words that rhyme aloud,  create new words and phrases from the initials, finals and tones given,  repeat saying the names of extended family members from a recording( 奶 奶,爷爷, 外婆, 外公 ),  use vocabulary acquired to introduce different family members using simple sentences (我爸爸叫……; 我爷爷 叫……),  ask and respond to questions on the names of their family members in turns (你外公叫什么名字？我外公叫……)  research the similarities and differences in the family units in KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Why is correct articulation of words important in communication?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 1.3 Phonological awareness
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.3 Phonological awareness. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) distinguish the different tones in Mandarin from listening texts, b) make simple descriptions in an organised and coherent manner, c) acknowledge the importance of tone discrimination in enhancing Mandarin proficiency. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen and repeat saying aloud the names of the learning areas offered in their school with the correct tones (数学、英 语、斯瓦希里语、综合科学、社会研 究,汉语),  listen and match vocabulary related to classroom stationery/items with the correct tones (铅笔、橡皮、尺子、卷 笔刀、粉笔、书、桌子、椅子、黑 板),  describe the colours (黑色，白色，棕 色，紫色，橙色，绿色，蓝色，红 色，灰色) of the various classroom stationery/ items displayed in turns (e.g. 你的铅笔是什么颜色? 我的铅笔 是……), KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do you communicate clearly in Mandarin Chinese?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 1.4 Imitative Speaking
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.4 Imitative Speaking. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify key words, phrases and expressions in listening texts, b) pronounce words with the correct speed, intonation and rhythm, c) appreciate the importance of imitation in fostering accurate pronunciation. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen and repeat saying verbs related to activities carried out at different moments of the day (起床、睡觉、 吃早饭、午饭、晚饭、做作业） and words related to moments of the day aloud (早上，上午，中午，下 午，晚上）,  listen and repeat a chant on my day (我的一天）with the correct sounds, tones, speed, intonation and rhythm,  match various activities (你什么时候 起床、睡觉、吃早饭、午饭、晚 饭、做作业?）to the appropriate moments of the day collaboratively (早上，上午，中午，下午，晚 上）,  use pictures/drawings to make a simple description on the activities they do at different moments of the day in turns, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How can you enhance your imitative speaking skills? 2. What do you do at different times of the day?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 1.5 Imitative Speaking
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.5 Imitative Speaking. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) replicate words, phrases and simple sentences from varied audio texts, b) express their likes and dislikes on familiar topics fluently, c) utilise appropriate vocabulary on familiar topics fluently, d) develop an interest in expressing themselves clearly in communication. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  watch an audio-visual clip on vocabulary related hobbies and interests（画画，跳舞，唱歌，听音 乐，看书，玩儿电子游戏）and repeat saying the words,  listen to a recording and match the pictures related to hobbies and interests to their correct pinyin and Chinese characters,  sing along the hobbies and likes song (爱好歌)with their peers,  play a guessing game where the learner acts out a verb related to hobbies/interests and the others say out the word,  respond to simple questions on hobbies and interests in turns （你的爱好是什 么？ 我的爱好是……你喜欢做什么? 我喜欢……),  talk about their hobbies/interests and those of their friends in turns, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. What is considered as effective communication? 2. Who is an effective communicator?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 1.6 Imitative Speaking
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.6 Imitative Speaking. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify keywords from oral texts in varied contexts, b) apply intonation and stress patterns in spoken language to convey meaning, c) exhibit interest in using intonation and stress patterns appropriately during oral interactions. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen to a recording on meals and indicate if the statements are true or false,  use pictures of the different times of the day to say what they eat at the given times (早餐、午餐、晚餐 ),  listen and repeat saying simple words and sentences related to meals of the day (红薯、面包、鸡蛋、奶茶、乌加 利、米饭、饼、炖豆、炖牛肉、蔬 菜)  say out a tongue twister on food (吃葡 萄）with the appropriate intonation and stress patterns collaboratively,  combine different food items from the list provided to make a healthy meal and form simple sentences (我今天早上吃 鸡蛋，面包和奶茶）, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Why is it important to articulate words clearly and correctly? 2. What strategies can be used to improve clarity when speaking?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 1.7 Listening for Gist
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.7 Listening for Gist. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify vocabulary related to a given theme in listening texts, b) determine the key information in varied oral presentations, c) exhibit interest in listening to texts for general understanding. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen to an audio recording and repeat words related to parts of the body (眼 镜，头，耳朵，鼻子，嘴巴，手，肚 子，角，退，舌头 etc.）,  listen to names of parts of the body and match them to their appropriate functions (e.g. 听, 看 , 闻, 走路, 跑步 etc.) collaboratively,  sing along to the body parts song (e.g. 头和肩膀 ) using the appropriate gestures with peers,  listen as their peers mention the functions of different body parts and point out the part of the body related to it,  listen to a riddle on the use of different body parts and solve it (e.g. 我们用什 么看？我们用眼睛看。),  discuss the importance of different parts of the body with peers. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do you pick out the main ideas from a listening text?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 1.8 Listening for Gist
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.8 Listening for Gist. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify specific information and details from everyday topics, b) listen for general understanding in different settings, c) acknowledge the importance of active listening to comprehend the central idea in spoken content. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  say out the weather patterns displayed in flashcards (晴天，雨天，(刮）风天， 阴天）,  listen to a recording and circle the option that is related to information on weather patterns,  compose a simple song on weather patterns collaboratively and make presentations,  listen to a simple weather forecast and respond to the questions given (今天、 明天、昨天天气怎么样？）,  look at a recent weather forecast and give simple descriptions of the weather pattern with peers,  talk about their favourite weather pattern in turns using pictures/images /drawings,  research online or from various sources the similarities and differences of weather patterns in Kenya and China KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How can you capture the gist when listening to various speakers or contexts?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 1.9 Listening for Gist
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.9 Listening for Gist. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) recall vocabulary in a given theme from a listening text, b) summarize the key ideas from oral texts in a concise and coherent manner, c) develop interest in understanding the core message in oral texts for comprehension. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen to an audio clip with prepositions and repeat saying them aloud（前边， 后边, 旁边，后边）,  listen to a song on different classroom items (铅笔，书，黑板，椅子，桌 子，橡皮，粉笔，尺子）and sing along with peers,  listen to a simple narration on locations of different items in their classroom and rephrase where they can be found collaboratively,  answer questions on the location of different items in their classroom in turns,  use the vocabulary acquired to build a word pyramid collaboratively e.g. 书 我的书 我的书在哪儿 我的书在桌子上, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: What strategies can you use to be a proficient listener?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.strand: Ability to utilise vocabulary and expressions in oral communication
chunks.sub_strand: Learner utilises all the targeted vocabulary and expressions in oral communication; attempts to use a variety of vocabulary and expressions synonymous to the targeted one’s, giving justifications for their choice
chunks.text: STRAND: Ability to utilise vocabulary and expressions in oral communication. SUB-STRAND: Learner utilises all the targeted vocabulary and expressions in oral communication; attempts to use a variety of vocabulary and expressions synonymous to the targeted one’s, giving justifications for their choice. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Learner utilises all targeted vocabulary and expressions in oral communication. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Learner utilises most of the targeted vocabulary and expressions in oral communication. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Learner utilises some of the targeted vocabulary and expressions in oral communication.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.strand: Ability to exhibit quality of language in oral communication (pronunciation, rhythm, pace and intonation)
chunks.sub_strand: Learner exceptionally exhibits correct pronunciation, rhythm and pace at all times in oral communication and applies intonation in different contexts to convey meaning effectively
chunks.text: STRAND: Ability to exhibit quality of language in oral communication (pronunciation, rhythm, pace and intonation). SUB-STRAND: Learner exceptionally exhibits correct pronunciation, rhythm and pace at all times in oral communication and applies intonation in different contexts to convey meaning effectively. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Learner exhibits correct pronunciation, rhythm and pace in oral communication and applies intonation in different contexts to convey meaning accurately. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Learner exhibits correct pronunciation, rhythm and pace most of the time in oral communication and applies intonation in different contexts with minor instances of misinterpretation. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Learner exhibits correct pronunciation, rhythm and pace some of the time in oral communication and applies intonation with difficulty in different contexts, leading to occasional misinterpretations.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.strand: Ability to respond to questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement in oral interactions
chunks.sub_strand: Learner responds to all questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement in oral interactions and goes further to give appropriate illustrations and examples
chunks.text: STRAND: Ability to respond to questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement in oral interactions. SUB-STRAND: Learner responds to all questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement in oral interactions and goes further to give appropriate illustrations and examples. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Learner responds to all questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement in oral interactions. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Learner responds to some questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement in oral interactions. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Learner responds to very few questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement in oral interactions.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.strand: Ability to interpret and use non-verbal cues to enhance oral expressions (body language, gestures, eye contact, facial expressions)
chunks.sub_strand: Learner interprets and uses adequate gestures and facial expressions in oral expressions when appropriate, is sensitive to cultural diversity and adapts non-verbal cues to suit diverse cultural contexts
chunks.text: STRAND: Ability to interpret and use non-verbal cues to enhance oral expressions (body language, gestures, eye contact, facial expressions). SUB-STRAND: Learner interprets and uses adequate gestures and facial expressions in oral expressions when appropriate, is sensitive to cultural diversity and adapts non-verbal cues to suit diverse cultural contexts. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Learner interprets and uses adequate gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions when appropriate. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Learner interprets and uses some gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions when appropriate. Some gestures and facial expressions used do not rhyme with the intended communication. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Learner interprets and uses some gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions when appropriate. Many of the gestures and facial expressions used do not rhyme with the intended communication.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 2.1 Reading Aloud
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 2.1 Reading Aloud. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) distinguish Chinese tones in monosyllabic and disyllabic words, b) read texts with appropriate pauses to enhance fluency and expression, c) appreciate the importance of punctuation pauses when reading aloud. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  read out pinyin words on greetings and self-introduction using the correct tone 我， 你，您，他，朋友，叫，什么， 名字， 是，不是，女孩，男孩,  match personal pronouns with the corresponding images and read them out （他，我，你，它，我们，你们，他 们,  rearrange jumbled up sentences on greetings and introduction and read them with peers,  read out texts on simple introductions paying attention to punctuation marks and respond to the questions (你朋友叫 什么名字？ ，她是谁？他是不是男、 女孩) collaboratively,  research online and offline the differences and similarities of punctuation marks in English and Chinese and share their findings. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Why is it important to pay attention to punctuation guides when reading?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 2.2 Reading Aloud
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 2.2 Reading Aloud. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify key words from a reading text, b) articulate simple sentences in text, c) appreciate the importance of reading aloud in oral communication. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  read out vocabulary related to extended family (奶奶,爷爷, 外婆 , 外公) in pairs,  place different family members on a family tree and read the names out,  read out sentences on extended family members (爸爸的爸爸叫爷爷）,  read out a dialogue of someone introducing their family and answer questions,  take turns mimic reading of a text related to nuclear family member for proper articulation,  research online or offline the function of grandparents role of a family in a Chinese nuclear family and make presentations.  research online or offline the role of a family in Kenya and China then make presentations. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Why is reading aloud important?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 2.3 Reading Aloud
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 2.3 Reading Aloud. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify key words and phrases from a reading text , b) read simple sentences with the appropriate speed and intonation, c) appreciate the importance of reading aloud for fluency. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen to a recording and repeat reading out vocabulary on stationery/items found in the classroom (铅笔、橡皮、 尺子、卷笔刀、粉笔、书、桌子、椅 子、黑板) and their colours (黑色，白 色，棕色，紫色，橙色，绿色，蓝 色，红色，灰色),  listen to their peers read out names of stationery/items and match them with the correct images,  mimic reading simple sentences on the various learning areas in their school with the correct pronunciation in turns (数学、英语、斯瓦希里语、综合科 学、社会研究, 汉语),  read out a short paragraph on the colour of classroom items and respond to the given questions (e.g. 你的笔是什么颜 色? ...... ), KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How can you improve your fluency when reading?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 2.4 Reading Aloud
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 2.4 Reading Aloud. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) replicate key words, expressions and phrases in Chinese, b) read simple sentences with the appropriate tone and volume, c) exhibit interest in reading texts aloud for language proficiency. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  circle names of moments of the day (早上，上午，中午，下午，晚 上）from a puzzle and read them out in turns,  read aloud verbs on various activities done during the day with peers (起 床、睡觉、吃早饭、午饭、晚 饭、做作业),  read simple sentences and sequence the activities given in relation to the appropriate moment of the day,  listen and repeat reading sentences on the moments of the day collaboratively (我早上起床，吃早 饭，我下午...),  read a simple text on moments of the day and answer the given questions,  discuss the essence of proper scheduling of activities in the day with peers for managing their time. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: What do you do at different moments of the day?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 2.5 Guided Reading
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 2.5 Guided Reading. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) recite key words, expressions and phrases in simple texts, b) read simple sentences on a given topic fluently, c) show awareness of the importance of correct articulation when reading texts. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  look at pictures depicting hobbies and interests and read them out （画画，跳 舞，唱歌，听音乐，看书，玩儿电子 游戏 etc.）,  match pictures to the corresponding sentences in pinyin and characters expressing interests and hobbies collaboratively (e.g. 我的爱好是听音 乐 wǒ de àihào shì tīng yīnyuè),  recite a simple poem related to hobbies and interests in turns,  read a simple passage and rephrase the main idea,  role play a dialogue asking about peers’ hobbies and interests（你的爱好是什 么？ 我的爱好是……你喜欢做什么? 我喜欢……),  explore how hobbies and interests can be used as a platform to raise awareness and advocate for various causes. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: What clues can help you comprehend a text?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 2.6 Guided Reading
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 2.6 Guided Reading. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify and read out vocabulary, b) articulate sentences clearly from texts, c) appreciate reading for pleasure on a variety of themes. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  read out names of meals displayed on flashcards,  indicate what one eats in relation to different times of the day (早餐、午 餐、晚餐 ),  identify the food items that don’t belong in the category given pictures based on the time when they are eaten collaboratively ,  repeat reading simple words and sentences related to meals of the day from the given text (红薯、面包、鸡 蛋、奶茶、乌加利、米饭、饼、炖 豆、炖牛肉、蔬菜),  read a short dialogue on food items and moments of the day then answer subsequent questions, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: What role does vocabulary play in reading comprehension?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 2.7 Guided Reading
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 2.7 Guided Reading. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) underline key words in a reading text b) highlight key information from texts c) appreciate role of vocabularies knowledge in comprehension SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  mimic reading the functions of different body parts (e.g. 听 tīng, 看 kàn, 闻wén, 走路 zǒulù, 跑步 pǎobù, 说 shuō e.t.c.)  match parts of the body and with their function and read out the matched pair collaboratively  play word search games to identify body parts and read out their functions(看，说，走，听，闻）and read out the words collaboratively  Read texts about functions of the body and answer simple questions  imitate reading texts on the functions of the body parts with the correct tones and summarise the text with a word or short sentence  play a card game of body parts and their functions (眼睛-看，腿-走，耳朵- 听，鼻子-闻） KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: What is the importance of vocabulary knowledge in reading?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 2.8 Guided Reading
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 2.8 Guided Reading. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify key words and phrases from a written text, b) articulate key words phrases and sentences in reading, c) appreciate the importance of correct pronunciation in communication. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  Read out words and phrases related to weather patterns from flashcards/ word charts in class (e.g. 晴天 qíngtiān，雨 天 yǔtiān，风天 fēngtiān，阴天 yīntiān 晴天, 雨天，风天，阴天),  chant out phrases and sentences related to weather pattern from a written text in class (e.g. 今天是阴 天。),  take turns to match pictures and corresponding weather pattern by rotating a weather display chart/ wheel and read them out,  read and answer questions on weather conditions collaboratively, e.g (明天 天气怎么样？明天是多云。）  Search online and offline with peers for some indicators of climate change and how to mitigate. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do you read confidently?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 2.9 Reading Aloud
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 2.9 Reading Aloud. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify key words and phrases while reading aloud, b) articulate punctuation pauses in reading, c) acknowledge the importance of reading words correctly. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  look at pictures of classroom items and read the correct name (铅笔，书，黑 板，椅子，桌子，橡皮，粉笔，尺 子）,  Look at pictures of different classroom items and fill in the right preposition (前 边，后边, 旁边，后边） then read the sentences aloud  read out sentences on location of different classroom items 我的书在桌 子上  read out the location of the items placed in different parts of the class as their peers locate where the items are placed,  read aloud simple sentences related to locating items in various areas of the classroom focusing on pronouncing the words accurately, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: What is the significance of correct pronunciation in reading?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.strand: Ability to read with fluency (smoothness, pace, pauses and intonation)
chunks.sub_strand: The learner reads simple texts with natural and smooth flow and at an appropriate pace all through. Pays attention to all punctuations and applies appropriate pauses and intonation to express intention and emotions. Makes no errors at all even in texts on unfamiliar topics
chunks.text: STRAND: Ability to read with fluency (smoothness, pace, pauses and intonation). SUB-STRAND: The learner reads simple texts with natural and smooth flow and at an appropriate pace all through. Pays attention to all punctuations and applies appropriate pauses and intonation to express intention and emotions. Makes no errors at all even in texts on unfamiliar topics. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: The learner reads simple texts with natural and smooth flow and at an appropriate pace all through. Pays attention to all punctuations and applies appropriate pauses and intonation to express intention and emotions. Makes minimal errors in texts SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner reads simple texts with natural and smooth flow and at an appropriate pace through most parts of the texts. Pays attention to most of the punctuations and applies appropriate pauses and intonation to express intention KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: The learner reads simple texts with stilted and choppy flow through most parts of the texts. Pays attention to very few punctuations as pauses and intonation are misplaced.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 3.1 Guided Writing
chunks.text: STRAND: Writing. SUB-STRAND: 3.1 Guided Writing. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) write syllables and words in dictations, b) compose short sentences in chinese, c) Appreciate the importance of correct spelling in writing. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen to a dictation and write down the words with the correct pinyin  Listen to an audio of a set syllables choose the one you hear （Tā, tǎ, tà、 Nǐ, nī, ní, nì）  writes short sentences on self introduction (我叫....、我是女孩，我 朋友叫.....。他是男孩),  join different strokes of basic greetings (你，好)using moldable material (pebbles, sand, cereals, plasticine, clay, thread etc.) to form characters and display them collaboratively,  complete the given sentences on greetings and self introduction with the missing punctuation marks. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: What is the importance of correct spelling writing?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 3.2 Guided Writing
chunks.text: STRAND: Writing. SUB-STRAND: 3.2 Guided Writing. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) list vocabulary in varied context b) write simple sentences in Chinese c) appreciate the importance of writing clearly. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  sort out jumbled up words to form names of the nuclear family  draw a family tree (Include 爷爷，奶 奶，外婆，外公）  write simple sentences introducing their family members (我妈妈叫.....)  answer simple question related to family members (爸爸的爸爸叫什么?)  join Chinese strokes to form characters on family, then stick to display (the strokes can be printed, sticks, plasticine, mud, grass etc)  compare and contrast members of the nuclear family in the Chinese set up against their own and note them down the differences and similarities in collaboration.  discuss the role of grandparents in the chinese set up and why they are part of the basic family unit. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How can you improve your writing?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 3.3 Guided Writing
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.0 Writing. SUB-STRAND: 3.3 Guided Writing. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) list names of items in Chinese, b) list words, phrase and expressions with the correct tones, c) write simple descriptions on a variety of topics, d) develop a love for writing Chinese Characters. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen to a recording and place the correct tone on the words and phrases given (ˉ ˊ ˇ ˋ 和 轻声),  look at actual/ pictures of classroom items and label them collaboratively, (e.g.铅笔qiānbǐ, 橡皮 xiàngpí, 尺子 chǐzi,书 shū,黑板 hēibǎn etc.)  circles names of colours in a word search with peers (e.g. 红色 hóng sè, 蓝 色 lán sè, 黄色 huáng sè,绿色 lǜ sè, 橙 色 chéng sè, 黑色 hēi sè, 白色 bái sè, etc. ),  look at flashcards/pictures of colours and label them in groups or pairs,  match classroom objects with their respective colours on a chart in class in groups or pairs,  write down descriptions of actual classroom items in terms of colour (e.g. Zhè shì hóngsè de bǐ; Wǒ de bāo shì hēisè de.), KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do you improve your writing skills?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 3.4 Guided Writing
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.0 Writing. SUB-STRAND: 3.4 Guided Writing. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) match words and phrases to meaning b) construct simple sentences in varied contexts c) appreciate the importance of writing in communication SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  List different activities done during different times of the day (起床，吃 饭，做作业，睡觉),  list activities of the day and link them with moments of the day (早上，上 午，中午，下午，晚上）,  Match images of different activities with their meaning,  answer simple questions on activities during different moments of the day,(你 上午做什么？）  rearrange scrambled up words and sentences on moments of the day and activities done during those moments  write a simple description of what they do in a day and present in class. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: What is writing important in communication?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 3.5 Guided Writing
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.0 Writing. SUB-STRAND: 3.5 Guided Writing. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) list words from a dictation, b) construct simple sentences in Chinese, c) value writing clearly for effective communication SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  Listen to an audio on hobbies and interests (唱歌，跳舞，油画，绘画玩 儿电脑）and write them down  Play a game of charades on different hobbies and guess the hobbies  look at a picture and write down the hobbies displayed  construct simple sentences on what they like and don't like (我喜欢唱歌，我不 喜欢跳舞,我爱，不爱）  create a table of likes and dislikes and write them down (喜欢，不喜 欢。。。）  create a scrapbook of their hobbies  Fill in a word puzzle on hobbies and interests  share the different hobbies and interests and write them in groups  discuss the importance of hobbies and interests with peers. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: What do you like doing at your free time?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 3.6 Guided writing
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.0 Writing. SUB-STRAND: 3.6 Guided writing. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) list down nouns in varied contexts b) compose sentences of various topics c) appreciate the importance of eating a balanced diet SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen to an audio and write down a list of food items (红薯、面包、鸡蛋、奶茶、乌 加利、米饭、饼、炖豆、炖牛肉、蔬菜) make a balanced meal form the list of food items provided （早饭，午饭，晚饭）  write simple sentences using the words provided  fill in blank spaces in simple sentences  using pictures and simple sentences make scrapbook on their favourite dishes  discuss the importance of eating a balanced diet KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: why is eating healthy food important?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 3.7 Guided Writing
chunks.text: STRAND: Writing. SUB-STRAND: 3.7 Guided Writing. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) list selected vocabulary from texts, b) write simple sentences on various topics. c) acknowledge the role of writing clearly in communication. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  match body part names with their correct functions from a table (eg. 眼 睛-看，腿-走，耳朵-听，鼻子-闻）,  listen to a dictation on body functions and list the respective parts associated with them ,  write the functions of the different body parts from the images provided,  Write short description describing different features in the body  Retrace characters on parts of the body and their functions following the correct stroke order (看，子，耳） KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: What role does handwriting play in communication?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 3.8 Guided Writing
chunks.text: STRAND: Writing. SUB-STRAND: 3.8 Guided Writing. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) list words from texts, b) construct simple sentences on various themes. c) show interest in writing clearly for effective communication. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  rearrange jumbled up letters/ words related to weather patterns to form correct words in groups or pairs,  write the names of weather patterns from the pictures provided,  fill in missing letters in given words in collaboratively,  Write simple sentences describing the weather (今天阴天）  Look at a weather forecast for a week and write sentences on the weather forecast (星期天雨天）  choose a weather pattern of their choice in groups and make a creative presentation with pictures and simple sentences. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How can one write effectively?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: Listening for gist
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: Listening for gist. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) highlight vocabulary from audio text, b) recognise key information in listening c) appreciate the role of listening to texts in building vocabularies SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen to an audio with prepositions and repreat（前边，后边, 旁边，后边）  listen to a song on different classroom items and sing along with the audio.  listen to a narration on locations of different items in the classroom (铅笔， 书，黑板，椅子，桌子，橡皮，粉 笔，尺子）and highlight the key information  answer questions on the location of different items in class collaboratively  build a word pyramid collaboratively 书 我的书 我的书在哪儿 我的书在桌子上 ● discuss the importance of having a neat environment for learning collaboratively KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How can we build vocabulary knowledge?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.strand: Ability to highlight vocabulary from audio text
chunks.sub_strand: Learner highlights vocabulary and their use from audio text
chunks.text: STRAND: Ability to highlight vocabulary from audio text. SUB-STRAND: Learner highlights vocabulary and their use from audio text. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Learner highlights vocabulary from audio text SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Learner highlights most of the vocabulary from audio text KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Learner highlights some vocabulary from audio text

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.strand: Ability to recognise key information in listening
chunks.sub_strand: Learner recognises key information and additional relevant details in listening
chunks.text: STRAND: Ability to recognise key information in listening. SUB-STRAND: Learner recognises key information and additional relevant details in listening. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Learner recognises key information in listening SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Learner recognises key information in listening with a few omissions KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Learner recognises key information in listening with a lot of omissions

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 9.2 Reading aloud
chunks.text: STRAND: Reading. SUB-STRAND: 9.2 Reading aloud. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify key words and phrases while reading aloud, b) articulate punctuation pauses in reading, c) acknowledge the importance of reading words correctly. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  look at pictures of classroom items and read the correct name (铅笔，书，黑 板，椅子，桌子，橡皮，粉笔，尺 子）,  Look at pictures of different classroom items and fill in the right preposition (前 边，后边, 旁边，后边） then read the sentences aloud  read out sentences on location of different classroom items 我的书在桌 子上  read out the location of the items placed in different parts of the class as their peers locate where the items are placed,  read aloud simple sentences related to locating items in various areas of the classroom focusing on pronouncing the words accurately, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: What is the significance of correct pronunciation in reading?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: Learner articulates punctuation pauses in reading in an engaging manner
chunks.text: STRAND: Ability to. SUB-STRAND: Learner articulates punctuation pauses in reading in an engaging manner. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Learner articulates punctuation pauses in reading SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Learner articulates punctuation pauses in reading with a few unnecessary pauses KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Learner articulates punctuation pauses in reading a lot of unnecessary pauses

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: 3.9 Guided Writing
chunks.text: STRAND: Writing. SUB-STRAND: 3.9 Guided Writing. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) write simple sentences from texts, b) compose texts on related topics, c) show enthusiasm in writing for effective communication. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  match pictures of the location of different areas to the appropriate words,  write words related to classroom items from a dictation(铅笔，书，黑板，椅 子，桌子，橡皮，粉笔，尺子）,  fill in missing words in given sentences with appropriate preposition with peers(前边，后边, 旁边，后边）,  use prepositions to make correct sentences(前边，后边, 旁边，后边）,  draw and colour images of common items in class with simple explanations of their locations,  share their writings with peers for peer assessment .  Collaboratively with peers discuss the safety of different places within the community KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How does composition help in enhancing communication?

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.strand: Ability to use vocabulary and sentence strictures in writing
chunks.sub_strand: Learner correctly uses a wide variety of grammar structures and vocabulary in writing with no errors
chunks.text: STRAND: Ability to use vocabulary and sentence strictures in writing. SUB-STRAND: Learner correctly uses a wide variety of grammar structures and vocabulary in writing with no errors. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Learner correctly uses a variety of grammar structures and vocabulary in writing with few errors which do not hinder understanding. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Learner uses some grammar structures and vocabulary in writing with frequent errors which interferes with understanding. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Learner uses some grammar structures and vocabulary in writing with many errors which interferes with understanding.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.sub_strand: Neat and easily readable, many letters are correctly spaced and sized within lines; many spaces between words are the correct size
chunks.text: STRAND: Handwriting. SUB-STRAND: Neat and easily readable, many letters are correctly spaced and sized within lines; many spaces between words are the correct size. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Untidy but readable; some letters are correctly spaced and sized within lines; some spaces between words are not the correct size. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Not easily readable, many letters are not correctly spaced and not sized within lines; many spaces between words are not the correct size. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Neat and easily readable throughout, many letters are correctly spaced and sized within lines; spaces between words are the correct size throughout.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.strand: Ability to organize texts in a logical and coherent manner
chunks.sub_strand: Learner exhibits an exceptionally clear sense of unity and order throughout, there is a clear sense of beginning, middle and ending and makes smooth transition between ideas
chunks.text: STRAND: Ability to organize texts in a logical and coherent manner. SUB-STRAND: Learner exhibits an exceptionally clear sense of unity and order throughout, there is a clear sense of beginning, middle and ending and makes smooth transition between ideas. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Learner exhibits a logical sequence, there is a sense of unity and order, there is a sense of beginning, middle and ending and makes smooth transition between ideas. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Learner attempts to provide a logical sequence, there is some sense of beginning, middle and ending and some smooth transition between ideas. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Learner exhibits no sense of order and provided a series of separate sentences and disconnected ideas and it is difficult to follow.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.sub_strand: 1.0 Whole Numbers
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.0 Whole Numbers (20 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to; a) use place value and total value of digits up to hundreds of thousands in real life, b) use numbers up to hundreds of thousands in symbols in real life, c) read, write and relate numbers up to tens of thousands in words in real life, d) order numbers up to tens of thousands in real life, e) round off numbers up to tens of thousands to the nearest hundred SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  identify place value of digits up to hundreds of thousands using place value apparatus,  identify total value of digits up to hundreds of thousands using place value apparatus,  read numbers up to hundreds of thousands in symbols from number charts or cards,  read and write numbers up to tens of thousands in words from number charts or cards,  arrange numbers up to tens of thousands in increasing and decreasing order using number cards and share with other groups,  discuss and round off numbers up to tens of thousands to the KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Where is ordering of numbers used in real life? 2. Why do we round off numbers?

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.sub_strand: 1.2 Addition
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.2 Addition (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to; a) add up to three 6 - digit numbers without regrouping up to a sum of 1,000 000 in different situations, b) add up to two 6 - digit numbers with double regrouping up to a sum of 1,000 000 c) estimate sum by rounding off the addends to the nearest hundred and thousand in different situations, d) create patterns involving addition of numbers up to a sum of 1,000 000 in real life situations, e) appreciate use of addition of whole numbers in real life situations. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● work out the sum of three 6 - digit numbers without regrouping up to 1,000 000 using place value apparatus, ● work out up to two 6 - digit numbers with double regrouping up to 1,000 000 using place value apparatus, ● estimate sums by rounding off the addends to the nearest hundred and thousand using a number line, ● create patterns involving addition of numbers up to a sum of 1,000 000 using number cards and other resources, ● play games involving addition of numbers KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How do you estimate the sum of given numbers? 2. How do you create patterns in addition?

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.sub_strand: 1.3 Subtraction
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.3 Subtraction (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to; a) subtract up to 6-digit numbers without regrouping in real life situations, b) subtract of up to 6-digit numbers with regrouping in different situations, c) estimate difference by rounding off the minuend and subtrahend to the nearest hundred and thousand in different situations, d) perform combined operations involving addition and subtraction in different situations, e) create patterns involving subtraction from up to 1,000 000 in different situations, f) appreciate subtraction of SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● work out subtract of up to 6- digit numbers without regrouping using place value apparatus, ● discuss and work out subtraction of up to 6-digit numbers with regrouping using place value apparatus, ● estimate difference by rounding off the minuend and subtrahend to the nearest hundred and thousand using a number line, ● work out questions involving addition and subtraction, ● create patterns involving subtraction of whole numbers from up to 1,000 000 using number charts, ● play games involving subtraction of numbers KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How do you estimate difference to the nearest hundred? 2. How can you create number patterns involving subtraction?

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.sub_strand: 1.4 Multiplication
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.4 Multiplication (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to; a) multiply up to a 3 - digit number by up to a 2 - digit number in real life situations, b) estimate product by rounding off numbers to the nearest ten in different situations, c) make patterns involving multiplication of numbers with product not exceeding 100 in in different situations, d) appreciate use of multiplication in real life. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● work out multiplication of up to a 3 - digit number by up to a 2 - digit number using different methods, ● estimate product by; - rounding off factors - using compatibility of numbers - own strategies, ● create patterns involving multiplication of numbers with products not exceeding 100, ● play games involving multiplication of whole numbers using digital devices and other resources. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Where is multiplication used in real life? 2. How can you form patterns involving multiplication?

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.sub_strand: 1.5 Division
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.5 Division (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to; a) divide up to a 3-digit number by up to a 2-digit number where the dividend is greater than the divisor in real life, b) apply the relationship between multiplication and division in different situations, c) estimate quotients by rounding off the dividend and divisor to the nearest ten in real life situations, d) perform combined operations involving addition, subtraction, multiplication and division of whole numbers in different situations, e) appreciate use of division of whole numbers in real life situations. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● work out division of up to a 3- digit number by up to a 2-digit number where the dividend is greater than the divisor using; - long and short form, - own strategies, ● discuss and demonstrate that multiplication is the opposite of division, ● estimate quotients by rounding off the dividend and divisor to the nearest ten, ● work out questions involving addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, ● create number games and puzzles involving division, ● play games involving division of whole numbers using digital devices and KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1) Where is division used in real life? 2) How can we estimate quotients?

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.sub_strand: 1.6 Fractions
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.6 Fractions (8 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to; a) simplify fractions in different situations, b) compare fractions in order to make decisions in real life, c) order fractions with denominators not exceeding 12 in different situations, d) add fractions with same denominator in different situations, e) subtract fractions with same denominator in different situations, f) add fractions with one renaming in different situations, g) subtract fractions with one renaming in different SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● identify equivalent fractions using a fraction board or chart, ● represent equivalent fractions using real objects, ● simplify given fractions using a fraction chart, ● compare given fractions using paper cut outs and concrete objects, ● order given fractions in increasing and decreasing order using a number line, paper cut outs, real objects, ● add two fractions with the same denominator using paper cut outs, number line, real objects, ● subtract two fractions with the same denominator using KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Why do we order fractions in real life? 2. Where are fractions used in real life?

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.sub_strand: 1.7 Decimals
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.7 Decimals (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to; a) identify place value of decimals up to thousandths in different situations, b) order decimals up to thousandths in different situations, c) add decimals up to thousandths in real life situations, d) subtract decimals up to thousandths in real life situations, e) appreciate use of decimals in real life situations. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● work out place value of decimals up to thousandths using a place value chart, ● order decimals up to thousandths from smallest to largest and from largest to smallest using number cards or number line, ● work out addition of decimals up to thousandths using place value apparatus, ● subtract decimals situations up to thousandths using place value apparatus, ● identify and share information on where decimals are used in real life, ● play games involving decimals using digital and other resources. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Where do you use decimals in real life? 2. What is the importance of ordering decimals?

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.sub_strand: 1.8 Simple Equations
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.8 Simple Equations (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to; a) form simple equations with one unknown involving real life situations, b) solve simple equations with one unknown involving real life situations, c) appreciate use of equations in solving problems in real life. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● discuss and form equations with one unknown from daily experiences, ● solve equations with one unknown, ● use digital devices or other resources to learn more about equations. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Where are equations used in real life?
